verdict.rationale: Nitrokey's docs list a dedicated "Nitrokey Provisioning for Entra ID" guide, and the product page promotes passwordless login to Microsoft services (Office 365). The docs also cover U2F login to sites like Google and Windows login via Active Directory, so integration with Microsoft's identity stack is evidenced, though only by titles and marketing lines. Missing for 10: any Okta integration, Google Workspace admin-level enrollment (beyond consumer Google U2F login), documentation of enforcing hardware-key-required policies, and fleet enrollment detail or independent/hands-on corroboration.
